description.text: The other expansion that opened the XY BREAK series on 26 September 2015, released together with Blue Shock and bringing the new BREAK Evolution. Its illustrations show Pokémon in a town of the near future, against Blue Shock's town rich in nature. It holds M Mewtwo-EX Y, its half of the split Mega Mewtwo pair, with Chesnaught BREAK, Marowak BREAK, Houndoom-EX and M Houndoom-EX. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 59, followed by full-art Super Rare Pokémon-EX and Giovanni's Scheme and an Ultra Rare gold Mewtwo-EX. In English it became part of BREAKthrough in November 2015, together with Blue Shock.
